Line 139 is in the commodity loop: duplicate (source,target) pairs. With ncoms=12 and `a = i % 11`, commodities 0 and 11 both have source N00 → duplicate pair (N00, N11) ✗.

Fix: ncoms ≤ 11. Let me set ncoms default 11 and clamp.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='gridgen.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    coms = []\n    for i in range(ncoms):", "    ncoms = min(ncoms, 11)\n    coms = []\n    for i in range(ncoms):")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
for cfg in "" "groups=3" "groups=14 tight=True" "max_faults=3" "ndoms=14 nsnap=4 groups=5 tight=True" "ncoms=11 groups=4 max_faults=6" "ndoms=14 nsnap=4 groups=2 tight=True max_faults=14"; do python3 gridgen.py $cfg > g.jsonl; echo "== cfg: [$cfg]"; ( timeout 100 bash -c "time ANALYZE_DEBUG=1 /workspace/submission/run.sh < g.jsonl > g.out 2>g.err" ) 2>&1 | grep real; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/g.out'));print(' ',d['status'],'k=',d.get('min_faults'),'nf=',len(d.get('faults',{}).get('possible',[])) if d.get('faults') else '-', 'forced=',len(d.get('faults',{}).get('forced',[])) if d.get('faults') else '-')"; tail -4 g.err; done
